issues.issue: The form does not break down Local Receipts. Irrigation district receipts are usually water tolls/charges (charges for services/fees) but may include land assessments (special assessments). The line is already marked review; category is a judgment call.
Function assumed from entity type. An irrigation district could also fit natural resources/conservation (the rules list water and drainage districts there). Defensible either way.

This is an irrigation district, not a public power district. Treating it as entirely business-type is defensible (the rules cover many water districts this way), but the entity_type label is questionable.
